title: Stacked multi-series time area
intent: Stack three tidy time series over a shared UTC axis. Observable Plot applies stackY to the raw rows; TanStack Charts consumes explicit y1/y2 intervals produced by granular d3-shape stack output, following the industry-unemployment fixture.

source.title: Observable Plot stack transform — stacked area

ai.create: Create a responsive stacked UTC area chart from tidy {id, date, value, series} rows. Plot may apply stackY directly; TanStack Charts must adapt granular d3-shape stack output into explicit y1/y2 channels while retaining series identity, stable keys, and the original values.
ai.maintain: Convert the chart to a normalized 100% stack. Use the corresponding Plot stack offset and granular D3 stack offset, update the y-axis formatting, and keep both implementations on the same raw tidy rows without casts or an umbrella D3 import.
